name: PT Global Sukses Solusi Tbk
summary: PT Global Sukses Solusi Tbk provides enterprise resource planning software solutions under the RUN System brand name for various business processes in Southeast Asia. The company provides various solutions for cost control, cash flow management, asset management, enterprise accounting, account payable, and account receivable; sales management, international trade logistics, and distribution management; and purchasing management, contract management, raw material purchasing, and e-procurement.
